tools.name: delete_automation_routine
tools.description: Permanently deletes a smart home automation routine and its schedule triggers from the home hub database.

params.name: routine_id
params.description: ID of the automation routine to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/smarthome/hub.db"


@dataclass
class DeleteRoutineResult:
    routine_id: str
    deleted: bool
    triggers_removed: int


@function_tool
def delete_automation_routine(routine_id: str) -> DeleteRoutineResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM routine_triggers WHERE routine_id = ?", (routine_id,))
        triggers_removed = cur.rowcount
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM routines WHERE id = ?", (routine_id,))
        deleted = cur.rowcount > 0
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return DeleteRoutineResult(
        routine_id=routine_id,
        deleted=deleted,
        triggers_removed=triggers_removed,
    )

tools.name: factory_reset_device
tools.description: Factory resets a smart home device by running the vendor reset command on the hub, then removes the device and its saved settings from the hub registry.

params.name: device_id
params.description: ID of the registered device to reset and remove

params.name: hub_cli_path
params.description: Path to the hub command line executable

tools.code:
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/smarthome/hub.db"


def factory_reset_device(device_id: str, hub_cli_path: str = "/usr/local/bin/hubctl") -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT protocol, address FROM devices WHERE id = ?", (device_id,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "device not found"})
    protocol, address = row
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [hub_cli_path, "reset", "--protocol", protocol, "--address", address, "--confirm"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        conn.close()
        return json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": proc.stderr.strip(), "code": proc.returncode})
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM device_settings WHERE device_id = ?", (device_id,))
    settings_removed = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM device_group_members WHERE device_id = ?", (device_id,))
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM devices WHERE id = ?", (device_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return json.dumps(
        {
            "ok": True,
            "device_id": device_id,
            "settings_removed": settings_removed,
            "output": proc.stdout.strip(),
        }
    )

tools.name: purchase_guest_access_subscription
tools.description: Charges the household payment method for a guest access subscription plan and grants the named guest a door lock access code for the plan's duration.

params.name: household_id
params.description: ID of the household making the purchase

params.name: guest_email
params.description: Email of the guest receiving access

params.name: plan_months
params.description: Number of months the guest access lasts

tools.code:
import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
LOCK_API_URL = "https://locks.internal.example.com/v1"
MONTHLY_PRICE_IN_CENTS = 499


@function_tool
def purchase_guest_access_subscription(household_id: str, guest_email: str, plan_months: int) -> dict:
    total_charge_amount_in_cents = MONTHLY_PRICE_IN_CENTS * plan_months
    household_stripe_customer_identifier = requests.get(
        f"{LOCK_API_URL}/households/{household_id}/billing", timeout=10
    ).json()["stripe_customer_id"]
    completed_payment_intent_for_guest_plan = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_charge_amount_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=household_stripe_customer_identifier,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Guest access {plan_months} months for {guest_email}",
    )
    guest_access_grant_response_from_lock_service = requests.post(
        f"{LOCK_API_URL}/households/{household_id}/guests",
        json={
            "email": guest_email,
            "months": plan_months,
            "role": "guest",
            "payment_id": completed_payment_intent_for_guest_plan.id,
        },
        timeout=10,
    )
    guest_access_grant_response_from_lock_service.raise_for_status()
    return {
        "payment_id": completed_payment_intent_for_guest_plan.id,
        "charged_cents": total_charge_amount_in_cents,
        "guest": guest_access_grant_response_from_lock_service.json(),
    }
